title: Technology Sector Update for 01/09/2018: ASX,UMC,IMOS,AAPL
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +0.41%
AAPL +0.28%
IBM +0.46%
CSCO -0.24%
GOOG +0.14%
Technology stocks were slightly underwater Tuesday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 declining just over 0.1% while the Philadelphia semiconductor index was sinking almost 1.0%.
In industry news:
+ Apple ( AAPL ) was narrowly higher Tuesday, climbing less than 0.3% to an intra-day high of $174.85 a share after the tech giant said "effectively everything" users can do on its devices can be blocked by parents. Responding to shareholder concerns over threats to children from electronic devices, Apple said it has "always looked out for kids" by creating products that "inspire, entertain and educate," an unnamed company spokeswoman told Reuters, adding it is also planning new features and enhancements in the future to improve parental control.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
Advanced Semiconductor Engineering ( ASX ) Tuesday was holding on to a small mid-day gain, giving back most of a nearly 1% advance to a session high of $6.70 a share that followed the chipmaker reporting Q4 revenue exceeding Wall Street expectations, rising 14.5% over year-ago levels to $2.79 billion, or TWD83.99 billion, and topping the Capital IQ consensus by around TWD2.59 billion.
In other sector news:
- United Microelectronics ( UMC ) fell Tuesday after reporting a 15% sales drop in December compared with year-ago levels.
- ChipMOS ( IMOS ) declined after saying its revenue fell during December and Q4 compared with the same quarter last year.
